# C++ Report Card snapshot / 报告快照

[![C++ Report Card](badge.svg)](https://github.com/soulteary/linkerbot-transport-cpp/actions/runs/41572932857)

This checked-in badge is the SVG generated by the successful ARM64
[main workflow run](https://github.com/soulteary/linkerbot-transport-cpp/actions/runs/41572932857)
for commit `895a76089e1d5cb9eb90ae4507c3c8d1a3b0320d`.

- Analysis complete: `true`; grade: **F**; score: **54/100**.
- clang-format: 50/50 files; Cppcheck and clang-tidy: 33/33 compilation entries each.
- The report contains 18 error-level diagnostics plus warnings. Findings require review;
  the score is not test coverage or proof that each diagnostic is a defect.

Download that run's `cppreportcard-ubuntu-24.04-arm` artifact for the full JSON and Markdown
reports. New workflow runs write the current reports and badge under `.github/cppreportcard/`
and upload them as artifacts. They do not automatically commit changes. Refresh this snapshot
from a completed run in a signed maintenance commit, updating the source commit and run link
together with `badge.svg`. See the [configuration and analysis scope](../../docs/en/build.md#c-report-card).
